tei:div.tei:p: (1na)chos rje dwags po lha rje'i gsung*/ mdo sngags kyi sgom don bsdus pa bzhugs so//

"$ (1ba)༄༅// na mo gu ru/ ngan song gsum gyi sdug bsngal gyis 'jigs nas/ skyabs su sangs rgyas nyag gcig yin par shes shing*/ srog gi phyir yang skyabs 'gro mi gtong ba ni/ skyes bu chung ngu'i chos yin pas/ dus rtag tu ngan song gsum gyi sdug bsngal soms la skyabs 'gro gyis/ 'khor ba mtha' dag la yid phyung nas/ rang thar pa mya ngan las 'das pa thob par 'dod pas/ mi dge ba bcu spong*/ dge ba bcu sgrub pa ni/ skyes bu 'bring gi chos yin pas/ dus rtag tu 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal soms la/ mi dge ba phra mo nas spongs/ dge ba mtha' dag dang du len par gyis/ 'khor ba'i ma rnams kyi sdug bsngal ma bzod nas de rnams kyi don du bla na med pa'i byang chub thob par 'dod pa ni/ skyes bu mchog gi chos yin pas/ dus rtag tu sems can la byams pa dang snying rje sgom pa la brtson par gyis/ ngan song gi sdug bsngal bsams pas/ ngan song la blo log nas mtho ris lha mi thob par 'dod pas/ dkon (2na)mchog gsum la skyabs su song bas/ mi dge ba bcu spong zhing dge ba bcu nyams su len pa yin no// de nas 'khor ba mtha' dag gi sdug bsngal bsams nas/ 'khor ba mtha' dag la blo log ste thar pa mya ngan las 'das pa thob par 'dod pas/ bsnyen par rdzogs pa dge slong gi sdom pa blangs/ 'dul ba sgrub thabs su byas nas tshe 'di la blo ldog pa yin no// de nas kun rdzob byang chub kyi sems bsgoms pas/ theg pa dman pa la blo ldog pa yin no// de nas bdag med rnam gnyis sgom pa yin te/ bka' gdams kyi gzhung shing de 'dra ba zhig yin gsung ngo*// gsang sngags kyi dbang du byas na yang*/ bka' gdams pa'i lugs su/ dang po nas rdzogs par mi ston/ dang po tshogs gsog tsam ston/ de nas bskyed rim gcig tsam ston/ de nas ye shes sems dpa' gzhug pa ston/ de nas dbang bskur mchod bstod/ de nas rdzogs rim ston pa yin gyi/

dang po nas rdzogs par mi ston/ dge bshes lcags ri (2ba)ba'i zhal nas/ lta ba kun rdzob yin/ mtha' gnyis dang bral ba'i dbu ma bya ba/ pha rol tu phyin pa'i lta ba yin/ don dam pa la blta rgyu med gsung*/ gsang sngags kyi lta ba sems yin gsung*/ nā ro pa'i bzhed pas/ ma smin pa smin par byed pa dbang gi lam/ smin pa grol bar byed pa bskyed rdzogs gnyis gdan thog gcig tu bsgom par bya ba dang*/ rim gyis pa'i lugs gnyis yin te/ gdan thog gcig tu sgom pa cig car ba'i dus su ston/ rim gyis pa ni 'og ma 'og ma la brtan pa thob nas/ gong ma gong ma ston te/ bskyed rim la brtan pa thob nas rdzogs rim sgom/ de yang nang nas shar ba de rdzogs rim gsha' ma de yin/ nang nas ma shar na zab pa'i rdzogs rim du ming btags kyang*/ don la blos byas cig yin gsung*/ spyir de ltar yin yang 'khor ba mtha' dag las thar bar byed pa la don dam byang chub kyi sems dgos te/ de yang*/ jo bo rje'i lugs kyis phyi nas spyod par bzhed/ bla ma mi la'i bzhed pas nang nas spyod pa yin/ bla ma ni bar der spyod/ sems nyid lhan cig skyes pa chos kyi sku/ bla ma'i bzhed pas/ rig pa dang stong pa lhan cig skyes gsung*/ de yang*/ grub pa thob pa'i skor nas bshad pa dang*/ rdo rje 'chang gi rgyud du gsungs pa dang*/ rnal 'byor pa la nang nas shar ba yo mthun/ bla ma'i zhal nas/ nang nas byung ba dang mi mthun na/ yang na rang gi nor/ yang na gzhan gyi nor gsung*/ tshan cig nas thabs gtso cher bshad/ tshan cig nas shes rab gtso cher bshad de/ blo dman pa'i dus su thabs gtso che ba man ngag yin/ blo yar song tsa na shes rab gtso che ba shugs kyis 'ong ba yin/ de yo la mi dgos snyam tsa na dgos bsdo ba cig yin gsung*/ shugs 'byung gis 'gag pa cig dgos pa yin/ shugs (3na)'byung zhes pa ni bcos ma dang bral ba cig yin/ sgom chen pa rnams la zhu na/

gnas pa'i dus su rtog med de rgyun srid pa yin/ ngo bo la rtog med rgyun bsring na chos kyi gnad ma go ba yin/ chos sha rus ma chod pa yin/ gdod ma nas rgyun chad ma myong ba'i gnad kas gsung ngo*// yang rin po che'i zhal nas/ don dam pa 'di 'dra ba cig yin bya ba ni/ sangs rgyas kyis kyang bstan par mi nus/ rgyun chad med pa de sangs rgyas kyis bkag pas kyang mi khegs/ sangs rgyas kyis gzigs par mi 'gyur gsung*/ dge bshes yon bdag gi zhal nas/ grub mtha' la brten nas rig pas gzhigs nas/ sha ba sgye'ur chud pa ltar 'gro sa 'di las med zer te/ khyod kyi de la rnam rtog blo phugs gtad byas pas/ de ni khyod rang gis bya ba yin na/ khyod kyi de ngo bor mi 'ong*/ phung 'dre mkhan po logs na yod par cha med par gsung ngo*// dge bshes lcags ri ba'i zhal nas/ klu sgrub kyi dbu ma rtogs su mi ster bar rab rib rnam pa gnyis yin te/ ma rig pa'i rab rib dang*/ lta ba'i rab rib bo// ma rig pa'i rab rib ni go sla/ lta ba'i rab rib ni/ grub mtha'i rtog pa sna tshogs kyis blo bslad pa de yin gsung ngo*// bla ma'i zhal nas/ de thams cad blos byas kyi grub mtha' bya ba yin gsung*/ sgom las ma byung gi lta ba dka' gsung ngo*// rin po che'i zhal nas/ bka' gdams pa yang lta ba la rtsis che ste/ grub mtha'i lta ba 'di ltar lags zer ba la rtsis mi che/ lta ba rang shar la rtsis che/ lar chos thams cad nyams thog nas smra ba cig dgos/ stong nyid shes bya'i gshis sgom pa dang*/ rtsa rlung sgom pa'i rten 'brel gyis nyams 'byung ste/ de yang nyams yin pa yin te/ des (3ba)chos sha rus chod pa mi 'ong*/ chos sha rus chod pa la/ don dam la skye med skyes pa'i nyams shig dgos gsung*/ kun rdzob sgyu mar mthong ba/ blo'i yul du byar mi 'dod/ dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas kyis kyang ma gzigs na/

rnam rtog gi blos mi mthong gsung ngo*// rin po che'i zhal nas/ gsang sngags kyi rgyud cig lam du slong ba yin te/ de yang rgyu gcig lam du slongs na yo slong ba yin/ de ci ltar slong na/ dbang bzhi pa lam du slong ba yin/ bum pa'i dbang gi dgos pa ci 'dra ba zhig yod na/ tha mal pa'i zhen pa ldog nas lha'i nga rgyal du byed pa yin/ nyon mongs pa lnga bzlog nas ye shes lngar byed pa yin/ gsang ba'i dbang gis rang la yod pa'i bde ba skyed par byed pa yin/ shes rab ye shes kyi dbang gis zag med kyi bde ba bskyed par byed pa yin/ tshig dbang rin po ches ni chos kyi sku ngo sprod par byed pa yin gsung*/ ma smin pa smin par byed pa dbang gi lam gyis smin par byas nas/ smin pa grol bar byed pa thabs bskyed rdzogs gnyis yin te/ de yang*/ ngo bo nyid kyi sku nyon mongs pa'i drwa ba thams cad dang bral ba/ bdag gi sems kyis stong nyid kyi rang bzhin bde bar gshegs pa 'ba' zhig gi spyod yul/ chos kyi dbyings kyi sems/ bde ba chen po'i bdag nyid rtogs par byed do// de yang*/ lha'i sku sgyu ma lta bu la brten nas bskyed rim gyi lam bsgoms pas/ zhi gnas dang lhag mthong gi ting nge 'dzin rgyud la skye ste/ rtog pa'i rang bzhin brgyad cu dang bral nas/ rtog med skye ba ni mchog dga'/ rtog pa'i rang bzhin bdun dang bral nas/ lhan cig skyes pa'i dga' ba'o// de'i dus na/ nang rtags lnga dang*/ phyi'i rtags brgyad la sogs pa dang*/ lus sems sbyangs pa'i rtags mang (4na)du 'byung ngo*// de ni bsam gtan dang po'i dngos gzhi yin na/ de la nges shes skyes nas chos sku mngon sum du thob par byed pa yin no// bla mas nges shes drangs nas bde ba rtog med sgom pa ni/ 'du shes kyi rnam par shes pa'i mngon sum gyi bsam gtan dang po'i dga' bde sgom pa yin no// de ltar nang gi dga' ba brtan pa'i stobs bzung ba/

stong nyid rtogs pa'i rnal 'byor gyi mngon sum yin no// de yang so so skye bo la ji ltar skye na/ gang dag bag chags srab pa dang*// rgyu rkyen rten 'brel 'dzom pa las// me long dag gi gzugs brnyan bzhin// sems nyid mngon sum dag gis rtogs// de lta bu'i sems nyid kyi stong nyid rtogs pa ni/ zag pa med pa'i sdom pa dang po'i mngon sum yin te/ sems nyid kyi stong nyid la nges shes skyes pa'i phyir ro// nges shes skyes nas/ sems nyid kyi stong nyid la tshad mas nges pa yin no// de la nges shes ma skyed na/ zag pa med pa'i sa bon ma skyes pas/ so sor brtags min gyi 'gog pa zhes bya'o// zhes gsungs so// yang rin po che'i zhal nas/ sems nyid 'gyur ba med pa/ rgyun chad pa med pa/ dus thams cad pa'o// 'gyur ba med pa ni/ dbyibs dang kha dog tu ma grub pas 'gyur ba med pa'o// rgyun chad med pa ni/ rig pa la rgyun chad med pa'o// dus thams cad pa ni/ dus 'di nas yod dang 'di nas med bya ba ma yin/ ma skyes shing ma 'gags pa'i phyir dus thams cad pa'o// sems grub mtha'i blos ma bsgyur ba rnam par rtog pa/ grub mtha'i blos bsgyur ba rnams la rnam par rig pa/ rtogs pa'i dus su ye shes so// shes pa shes rab/ shes bya gsum gang zhe na/ shes pa ni rang rig pa'i ngo bo// (4ba)shes bya ni blo'i yul du gyur pa thams cad shes rab ni de nyid rtogs par byed pa la bya'o// zhes gsung ngo*// yang rin po che'i zhal nas/ tshe 'di blos btang nas chos gsha' mar byed pa la/ bla ma ma nor ba zhig dang 'phrad dgos/ chos ma nor ba zhig dang 'phrad dgos/ bla ma nor ba dang phrad na/ chos nor ba dang phrad nas lam ma nor ba rgyud la mi skye/ de ma skyes na/ 'bras bu ma nor ba rgyud la mi 'char/ de ma shar na sangs mi rgya/ des na/ bla ma ma nor ba zhig dang phrad na/ chos ma nor ba zhig dang phrad/

de dang phrad pas lam ma nor ba rgyud la skye/ de rgyud la skyes pas 'bras bu ma nor ba rgyud la 'char gsung*/ chos gsha' ma zhig byed na/ dang po mi rtag pa bsgoms pa'i stobs kyis tshe 'di la blo ldog pa zhig dgos/ de nas 'khor ba'i nyes dmigs bsgoms pas/ 'khor ba mtha' dag la blo ldog dgos/ de nas byams snying rje byang chub kyi sems bsgoms pas/ 'khor ba na gnas pa'i ma rnams kyi don du sangs rgyas thob par 'dod pa zhig dgos/ byang chub kyi sems rnam gnyis rgyud la skyes na sangs rgyas/ de gnyis ma skyes na sangs mi rgya/ bsod nams kyi tshogs gsog pa dang*/ bskyed rim sgom pa dang*/ bzlas pa byed pa la sogs pa yang*/ de gnyis kyi zhabs tog gi tshul du byed pa yin/ kun rdzob sgyu ma tsam du byams snying rje byang chub kyi sems dang mi 'bral gsung*/ bsgom par bya ba ni/ phyi gzung ba'i yul dang*/ nang 'dzin pa'i sems yin te/ phyi gzung ba'i yul rlung gi dkyil 'khor nas/ srid pa'i rtse mo'i bar 'di dag ni rdzun pa yin te/ de dang po nas yod ma myong ba yin/ dper na rmi lam na zas zos pa dang*/ skom 'thungs pa la sogs pa rmi yang*/ gnyid sad pa na gang yang ma grub pa de (5na)bzhin du/ da ltar 'khor ba'i chos sna tshogs su snang yang*/ bden pa mthong ba'i dus su gang yang ma grub/ des na da lta yang bden par mthong ba yang rdzun pa yin la/ rdzun pa'i ngo bo yang bden pa yin/ snang ba rmi lam sgyu ma tsam du shes par bya'o// nang 'dzin pa'i sems 'di nyid kyang ngos bzung med pa yin te/ dang po ma skyes/ tha ma mi 'gag /rgyu rkyen gyis ma bskyed de/ gang du yang 'gyur ba med/ ma skyes mi 'gag nam mkha'i ngo bo nyid// ces gsungs/ sangs rgyas kyi thugs la mnga' ba dang*/ sems can gyi sems gnyis la bzang ngan med/ rtogs ma rtogs kyi khyad par yin/ blos byas kyi stong pa yang dang yang du bsgom/

brtags te/ sems kyi ngo bo de dang po nas mthong ma myong bar yod pa yin/ sems kyi mtshan nyid ni/ rtog pa sna tshogs su 'phro ba 'di sna tshogs su shar ba yin/ skyes bu shes rab chung ba ni/ sems dang rtog pa tha dad du rtogs/ shes rab can ni gnyis su med par rtogs te/ rtog pa sems las byung zhing sems la thim ste/ chu dang rlabs bzhin du gnas pa yin no// sems kyi rang bzhin ni/ 'od gsal ba ci'i ngo bor yang ma grub pa yin/ dang po blo gsar pa'i dus su/ gang nas skyes/ gar 'gag /ci ltar gnas bltas pas blo nges par byed pa yin/ de nyid blo cher song nas/ ma bcos pa'i shes pa rang gsal la 'jog pa yin/ yul de nyid la/ dad pa brtson pa gus pas nan tan gyis rgyun ring bar bsgom par bya ste/ chu bo la rgyun chad med pa dang*/ mar me'i rtse mo rlung gis ma bskyod pa dang*/ bu gcig po shi ba'i ma bzhin du/ nyin mtshan du 'bad na/ lo 'ga' zla ba 'ga' na don grub ste 'ong gsung ngo*// pha rol tu phyin pas/ kun rdzob (5ba)tu gzugs stong pa/ stong pa nyid gzugs gnyis med du bzhed la/ don dam par chos thams cad mi dmigs par bzhed do// don dngos lam du byed pa ni gsang sngags te/ tai lo pas/ rang gi rig pa ni/ de kho na nyid kyi ye shes te de la bstan du ci yang med/ zer ba lta bu ste/ lta ba gnyis su med pa/ nyams myong rgyun chad med pa/ sgom pa phyogs su ma ltung ba/ spyod pa dgag sgrub dang bral ba/ 'bras bu re dwogs dang bral ba yin/ zhes gsung ngo*// ༈ // chos rje dwags po lha rje'i nyams len gyi gnad bsdus pa lags// na mo gu ru/ rin po che'i zhal nas/ 'chi ba mi rtag pa sgom pa gal che/ de yang 'chi ba bsgoms pas tshe 'di la blo ldog dgos/ mi rtag pa bsgoms pas 'khor ba mtha' dag las blo ldog dgos/ 'khor ba'i nyes dmigs dang las rgyu 'bras bsgoms pas/ nyes pa mtha' dag las blo ldog dgos/

byams snying rje byang chub kyi sems bsgoms pas/ rang zhi bde 'dod pa las blo ldog dgos/ chos thams cad stong nyid du bsgoms pas/ dngos po dang mtshan mar 'dzin pa las blo ldog dgos/ zhes gsung ngo*// //yang rin po che'i zhal nas/ dad pas khams gso nus pa/ tshul khrims la ngo lkog med pa/ gdams ngag la rang byan tshud pas/ lus sems kyi gnod pa phra mo sel nus pa/ gnyen pos rkyen thub pa zhig dgos gsung*/ yang rin po che'i zhal nas/ nga'i mi rtag pa 'di ston pa rnams kyi ma go /btsun po rnams kyis ma go /shes rab can gyis ma go /dad pa can gyis ma go /mi rtag pa nan ltar go na/ tha mal gyi long skad cig kyang med par/ dge ba 'ba' zhig byed pa ste/ chos kho na byed pa zhig 'ong ba yin te/ gsung*/ dge ba'i bshes (6na)gnyen pa'i zhal nas/ khyed la long 'dug ste/ nga la sbur ba rgad po zhig gi tshe las med gsung ngo*// yang rin po che'i zhal nas/ 'o skol sgom chen pa rnams la/ nang rtags phyir 'char ba zhig dgos/ chos brgyad ro ma snyoms ring la khas blangs bzang bas mi phan/ so tshugs pa dang*/ mtha' chod pa gnyis dgos gsung ngo*// //bla ma dam pa rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// bla ma'i zhal nas/ blo nges su 'dod na chos gang spyad kyang zab/ blo nges su ma 'dod na chos gang spyod kyang mi zab/ dge bshes ston pas gsang sngags kyi chos bsam gyis mi khyab pa mkhyen te/ khong skyes bu gsum la nges pas/ dus rtag tu byams dang snying rje la goms par mdzad pa la/ 'gro ba thams cad dad par gyur/ da lta bka' gdams kyi bstan pa dar bar byed pa/ khong gi skyes bu gsum la byed pa yin/ de bzhin du/ lo ts+tsha ba rin chen bzang pos gong du paṇ+ḍi ta bcu drug dang mjal te/ byams snying rje'i gdams ngag med/ jo bo chen po rje dang mjal nas/ byams pa dang snying rje la blo nges pas/ khong grub pa thob par gyur/ de bzhin du/ rnal 'byor pa gsum man chad nas dge bshes jo bo yan chad bka' gdams pa de thams cad skyes bu gsum la blo nges pas/

byams snying rje bsgoms pa las byung ba yin/ de bas na/ kun rdzob byang chub kyi sems 'di gal che/ 'di dang por mkho ste/ 'di med na theg chen gyi lam du mi tshud/ bar du mkho ste/ 'di med na nyan thos la sogs par ltung*/ tha mar mkho ste/ 'di med na sku gnyis mi 'byung ngo*// mi rtag pa 'di yang dang por mkho ste/ 'di med na tshe 'di la blo mi ldog /bar du mkho ste/ 'di med na rtag par bzung ste nyan thos la sogs par (6ba)gol/ tha mar mkho ste/ mi rtag pa dang stong pa don gcig yin no// las dang 'bras bu 'di yang dang por mkho ste/ tshul khrims rnam par dag na ngan 'gro'i sgo khegs pa yin no// bar du mkho ste/ sgyu ma rmi lam tsam du tshogs gnyis rdzogs par byed pa yin/ tha mar mkho ste/ kun rdzob mthar phyin gzugs sku rnam gnyis yin/ des na lam rim rtsis su che gsung*/ de rnams rgyud la mi ldan na/ gnyug ma rab rib cig skyes kyang*/ yul dang nye du la chags na gnyug ma des mi phan/ mar 'gro ba las yar mi 'gro gsung*/ tshe 'di la chags par ma byed/ snang grags kyi chos thams cad sgyu ma rmi lam lta bur nges su chug /byams snying rje byang chub kyi sems sbyongs/ de ltar nges na gnyug ma med kyang*/ kho yar 'gro ba las mar mi 'gro /'o na gnyug ma rnal ma zhig rgyud la skyes na/ gnyug ma'i ngo bo/ gnyug ma'i 'bras bu/ gnyug ma'i rgyu gsum/ ngo bo ni/ med pa ma yin pa'i don skye 'gag thams cad dang bral ba de yin/ 'bras bu ni/ skye 'gag med pa de nyid chos sku yin/ de las gzugs sku gnyis 'byung*/ gzugs sku yang gnyug ma'i bde gsal mi rtog pa las byung bas/ sku gsum gnyug ma'i 'bras bu yin/ bde gsal de gtum mo las 'byung bas na gnyug ma'i rgyu yin/ gnyug ma skyes kyang gtum mo med na/ shes rab rkyang pa yin/ gtum mo yod na/ thabs shes ya ma bral ba yin gsung ngo*// bla ma mi la'i zhal nas/

sgom pa las ma byung gi lta ba dka' bas/ gtum mo la 'bad pa gal che gsung*/ gang zag dbang po rab 'bring gsum la chos ci lta bu zhig dgos na/ pha rol tu phyin pa'i bzhed pa ni/ skyes bu gsum las/ (7na)skyes bu mchog ni byams snying rje byang chub kyi sems la blo sbyangs nas/ lta ba dbu ma mthar thug rtogs pa yin/ skyes bu 'bring ni/ gzhi skyes bu 'bring gi chos la byas nas/ nyams len chos thams cad mi rtag par go ba de yin/ skyes bu chung ngu ni/ gzhi skyes bu chung ngu'i chos la byas nas/ lag tu ci len na/ ngan song gsum gyi sdug bsngal gyis 'jigs nas/ las 'bras la yid ches nas rnal mar 'jog pa de yin/ de la skyes bu chung ngur btags kyang*/ 'jig rten pa yi yang dag lta// chen po su la yod gyur pa// de ni tshe rabs stong du yang*// ngan 'gro dag tu 'gro mi 'gyur// zhes gsungs so// 'o na'ang*/ skyes bu chung ngu de yang*/ ngan song gsum gyi sdug bsngal las 'das nas/ mtho ris lha mi sangs rgyas kyi tshod tsam yin te/ mig yar la bltas pa'i dus na/ 'khor ba gang la yang skyid med/ 'khor ba'i mtshan nyid ri bo mes tshig pa'i dbus na rang nyid 'dug pa'am/ rgya mtsho'i dkyil du gzings 'byams pa'am/ gtsang po'i dkyil du gru 'byams pa ltar ro// mdor na/ mya ngan las 'das pa ci thob byed dgos/ skyes bu 'bring de/ nyan thos kyi lam yin/ dgra bcom pa'i 'bras bu thob ste/ des mi 'ong bas/ bla na med pa'i byang chub ci thob byed dgos/ de ni pha rol tu phyin pa'i lam ma yin/ thabs bskyed rdzogs gnyis yin te/ de yang bskyed rim gyis zung 'jug rtogs pa sgrub/ bskyed rim 'bring dang tha ma gnyis kyis tha mal gyi zhen pa bzlog /rab kyis rang lhar mthong*/ ji ltar mthong na/ rigs lngar mthong*/ lha mo lngar mthong*/ byang chub sems dpa' bcu drug tu mthong*/ de la sogs pa/ phyi nang gang byed (7ba)kyi lhar mthong*/

'bring gis sgyu mar nges/ tha mas mos pa byed do// rdzogs rim ni/ rab kyis rang nyid sangs rgyas su mthong*/ 'bring gis ngo bo skye med du rtogs/ tha mas spros bcas la brten nas rtse gcig spyod do// 'o na pha rol tu phyin pa dang khyad par gang zhe na/ pha rol tu phyin pa don spyi'i rnam pa yul du byed pa zhes bya ba/ phyi gzung ba'i yul 'di gcig dang du bral gyis gzhigs nas stong par byed/ gzung ba med na der 'dzin med/ gzung yul rtsad chod na/ 'dzin pa sgrog rang brdal la 'gro zer nas/ nang 'dzin pa'i sems la rtog dpyod mi gtong ngo*// gsang sngags pa ni/ phyi gzung ba'i yul la rtog dpyod mi gtong*/ rgyas 'debs byed/ sems dang po gang nas skyes bltas pas/ gang nas kyang ma skyes/ bar du gang na gnas bltas pas gang na yang mi gnas/ tha ma gar 'gag bltas pas/ gar yang mi 'gag /rang bzhin ci lta bu 'dug bltas pas/ ci'i ngo bor yang ma grub pa/ de lta bu'i don ci yang ma yin pa de la rig pa zhes bya ste/ ye shes kyi spyod yul yin gyi/ rnam rtog gi blo'i yul ma yin no// des na/ so so rang rig ye shes spyod yul ba// zhes gsungs so// de lta bu'i don de la gnas na/ tha mar mi 'dzin pa'o// pha rol tu phyin pa dang gsang sngags gnyis kyi khyad par la/ pha rol tu phyin pa ni don spyi'i rnam pa yul du byed/ don spyi'i rnam pa ni/ chos thams cad kyi mtshan nyid gcig dang du bral gyis gzhigs nas/ ma grub pa zhig la brten nas/ chos thams cad ma grub par byas nas/ nam mkha' rnam par dag pa ltar blos byas nas 'jog pa ni/ don spyi'i rnam pa yul du byed pa yin no// don dngos lam du byed pa ni/ thabs (8na)lam drag tu bcun pas/ rlung a wa dhū tir tshud de/ de'i dus su rlung sems gnyis su med pas/ shes pa gsal la mi rtog pa 'byung ste/ de'i dus su bla ma zhig gis/ khyod kyi shes pa gsal la mi rtog pa de ni/

rang gi sems rig pa kho na yin no// zhes ngo sprad nas/ khos de kho na ltar bsgoms pas/ gsal ba dang mi rtog pa la mchog 'dzin btang ste/ rig pa de la nges shes skye'o// rig pa de kho na gsal ba de nyid la ma yengs pa ni ting nge 'dzin to// rdo rje lta bu'i ting nge 'dzin mthar phyin pa chos kyi sku'o// lam rnam pa gsum ni/ gzhi spong ba'i lam/ gzhi sgyur ba'i lam/ gzhi shes pa'i lam mo// gzhi spong ba'i lam ni/ nyon mongs pa spong bar 'dod cing*/ gnyen po ye shes rgyud la skye bar 'dod pa ni/ pha rol tu phyin pa'o// gzhi sgyur ba'i lam ni gsang sngags ste/ ci ltar sgyur na/ chos thams cad gzhal yas khang dang*/ lha dang lha mor sgyur/ zas thams cad bdud rtsir sgyur/ rang lhar sgyur/ nyon mongs pa ye shes su sgyur/ gzhi shes pa ni/ chos thams cad la spang rgyu med/ blang rgyu med sgyur rgyu yang med par thams cad sems su 'dus/ sems kyi rnam 'phrul yin/ skye med 'od gsal bar shes pa ni/ gzhi shes pa ste gsang sngags so// rdo rje 'chang gis/ sgom med sgom pa po yang med// bsgom par bya ba cung zad med// ces gsungs te/ rnal 'byor pa ni sangs rgyas la mi nyan/ sangs rgyas mi bden/ sgom pa yod/ ci ltar yod na rig pa rang yin/ nga'i rig pa gsal la go ma 'gags pa/ rgyun chad med par 'di sgom/ sgom pa po yod do// ci ltar yod na/ nga'i ngo bo 'dis sangs rgyas kyi bcad par (8ba)mi nus pas nga rang yin/ bsgom par bya ba yang yod/ nga la nyams su myong ba en tsam yod/ 'o na nga sangs rgyas bden/ nga sangs rgyas kyi rjes su 'brang*/ sgom pa med/ ci ltar med na/ rang rig ngos bzung dang bral ba/ dpe dang tshig gang gis kyang mtshon du med/ mtshan ma'i ngos nas dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas kyis kyang gzigs par mi 'gyur/ de'i ngo bo la bsgom par bya ba'i yul med/ nga gsal bar mi 'dod de ngos bzung yin/

nga mi rtog pa mi 'dod de/ de yang ngos bzung yin/ dpe gang gis kyang mtshon du med/ tshig gang gis kyang thog tu mi phebs/ nga la bcas bcos ma mang rang gar zhog /ces gsungs so// yang rin po che'i zhal nas/ sems nyid lhan cig skyes pa chos kyi sku dang*/ snang ba lhan cig skyes pa chos sku'i 'od gnyis yin/ de la sems nyid lhan cig skyes pa ni/ sems kyi rang bzhin nam ngo bo de yin/ snang ba lhan cig skyes pa ni/ de las byung ba'i rnam par rtog pa de yin/ de yang nyi ma dang nyi ma'i 'od bzhin nam/ tsan+dan dang tsan+dan gyi dri lta bu yin no// de la rtogs par bya ba'i chos gsum dang*/ nyams su blang ba'i chos gsum mo// rtogs par bya ba'i chos gsum ni/ snang ba lhan cig skyes pa ci yang ma yin pa la sna tshogs su shar ba shes par bya/ sna tshogs su shar yang don ci yang ma yin par shes par bya/ gnyis med smrar mi btub par shes par bya'o// nyams su blang bya'i chos gsum ni/ sems nyid lhan cig skyes pa/ dang po rtsol sgrub dang bral bas lus sems khong glod pa dang*/ bar du the tshom dang bral ba sems ma bcos par so mar bzhag pa dang*/ tha ma byung tshor thams cad skye med du shes par (9na)bya'o// 'chi ba bsgoms pas/ tshe 'di'i don mi byed/ 'khor ba'i nyes dmigs bsgoms pas 'khor bar mi skye/ las dang 'bras bu bsgoms pas ngan song du mi skye/ byams snying rje byang chub kyi sems bsgoms pas nyan rang du mi ltung*/ zab mo stong nyid bsgoms pas/ gzugs khams dang gzugs med khams su mi skye/ 'chi ba bsgoms pa la/ yon tan lnga/ phan yon gsum yod de/ gang zhe na/ skyo ba skye ba yin/ dad pa gso ba yin/ brtson 'grus can du 'gyur pa yin/ 'jig rten la mi chags pa yin/ mya ngan las 'das pa la phyogs pa yin/ 'chi ba sgom pa la rab 'bring gsum yod/ rab kyis dngos po zhag tu mi 'dzin/ 'bring gis zla bar mi 'dzin/

tha mas lor mi 'dzin pa yin gsung*/ bla ma'i gdams ngag yi ger bris pa'o// yang bla ma'i zhal nas/ mi dmigs pa gsum ni/ sbyin pa mi dmigs/ sbyin pa po mi dmigs/ sbyin pa'i dngos po mi dmigs/ sems kyi rnam 'phrul yin/ sbyin pa'i yul mi dmigs/ sems kyi rnam 'phrul yin/ sems skye med 'od gsal ba yin/ 'od gsal gnyis 'dzin gyi shes pa dang bral na mi dmigs pa'o// zhes gsungs so// ༈ //na mo gu ru/ bde gshegs sprul pa bla ma dam pa yis// rang sems sangs rgyas yin par ngo sprad nas// nges shes skyes pa'i nyams myong tshig dang bral// 'khor 'das gnyis 'dzin rnam par rtog pa yang*// brjod med spros bral chos sku'i ngang du thim// rtag chad gnyis kyi mtshan ma rang sar grol// zag bcas bde ba lus kyi dkyil nas shar// zag med bde ba dngos po kun la (9ba)khyab// zhen pa med pa'i lta ba nam mkha' 'dra// rgyun chad med pa'i nyams myong chu bo 'dra// re dwogs med pa'i 'bras bu lhun gyis grub// de lta'i don cig nyams su myong 'dod pas// bla ma spyi bor khur bas lam la yid ches bya// sdug bsngal dang du blangs pas bde ba shugs la 'byung*// dngos po'i zhen pa btang bas snang ba sgyu mar 'char// thams cad rdzun du shes pas nye du'i gdung sems bral// gar bde'i ri khrod 'grims na gnas kyi zhen pa bral// 'dus pa 'bral bar shes na grogs kyi zhen pa bral// bsags pa 'dzad par go na nor gyi zhen pa bral// khams kyi zas la rten la nyams myong sems la bskyang*// stong nyid snying rje 'dres na sgom la gol sa med// dman pa'i sa la 'dug na dug lnga ngang gi zhi// hrul po'i gos la rten la thabs kyi zhabs tog 'bad// rigs drug g.yang sa che bas dam tshig sdom pa bsrung*// mi lus thob par dka' bas da res brtson 'grus 'bad// lta ba tshig tu 'chor bas nyams kyi brlan la gtso// nyams myong blos byas yin pas don la snyems thag bcad// chos brgyad sngon du song ba'i spyod pa tshul 'chos yin// re dwogs gnyis dang bral na 'bras bu lhun gyis grub// 'gro la snying rje bskyed na gzhan don shugs las 'byung*// thabs kyi dam pa yin pas bsngo bas zin par gyis// nyams myong yi ger bkod pa mkha' 'gros bzod par gsol// bsdus pa'i nyams len// //

bla ma ti phu pa dang*/ a nu ta ra badz+ra dang*/ bla ma mi la rnams/ da ltar lam gyi lam 'od gsal/ bar do lam gyi 'bras bu 'dres par bzhed pa yin/ bla ma bal po dang nyi ma'i ris la rtsod pa byas/ lam gyi 'od gsal ngos ma zin par/ 'bras bu'i 'od gsal bar dor zin pa mi srid/ gdams ngag med pa rnams 'od gsal las langs nas/ lus tshol bas 'khor bar skye gsung*/

zung 'jug rnam 'gyur gyi man ngag yin/ bla ma rje btsun rnams la phyag (10na)'tshal lo// bdag nyid bde yid dag la gdung mi bya// bdag nyid za zhing 'thung la gnyis sbyar te// dga' ba'i yid kyis spro bar byed pa ni// nga dag yang dang yang du 'khor lo 'gengs// chos 'dis 'jig rten pha rol 'grub 'gyur te// rmongs pas 'jig rten mgo brtags bzhag nas song*// zhes bya ba'i don ni/ rnal ma'i don no// gnyug ma'i don nyid nyams su myong ba ni/ rnal 'byor pa bdag nyid la bde ba skyes kyang*/ yid gdung bar mi bya'o// 'o na bsgom par bya ba ma yin nam zhe na/ rnal 'byor pa bdag nyid gnyug ma'i ting 'dzin de dag gi zas za zhing*/ bla ma'i gdams ngag skom du 'thung la/ bde ba dang stong pa dang gus pa'i sgo nas yun ring du nyams su blangs pas 'byung ngo*// lus sems sbyangs pa'i rtags mang du 'byung ste/ srog dhū tir tshud pa'i stobs kyis/ rtags lnga dang phan yon brgyad la sogs pa yon tan mang du 'byung ngo*// de lta bu'i lus sems bde ba ci byung yang zhi gnas yang yin te/ 'on kyang rtags lnga dang phan yon brgyad po de zhi gnas dang*/ lhag mthong zung du 'brel ba las 'byung ste/ dmigs pa phra mo zin pa'i gnas pa lteng lteng la mi 'byung ngo*// de lta bu'i ting nge 'dzin de bsam gtan dang po'i dngos gzhi yin gsung*/ de yang lus kyi rnam par shes pa'i bsam gtan gyi dga' ba sgom pa yin gsung*/ bla ma sems kyi stong nyid mngon sum du byas pa cig gis/ skye med nges su 'jug ste/ ma nges na snang ba lam nges pa zhes bya'o// de yang*/ lus kyi rnam par shes pa zag bcas kyi bde ba mngon sum gyis skye med du nges su 'jug ste/ ma nges na snang la ma nges pa zhes bya ste/ so sor brtags min gyi 'gog par 'gro /thun mong gi lam po yin pas gar skye cha med gsung*/ nges pa'i (10ba)shes pa skyes na/

rtog pa dang bral ba'i stong nyid kyi yul mngon sum gyis rab tu shes gsung ngo*// sems skye med kyi ngo la ma nges na/ bla ma'i zhal nas/ de de yin te de de min// sdong po yin te 'bras bu min// yon tan yin te rtog med min// zhes gsung*/ jo bo'i zhal nas kyang*/ nges sbyangs bag chags bral bas rnal 'byor ma mthong ba// nam mkha'i me tog blangs pas 'jigs pa mthong ba 'dra// zhes gsungs// de bas na/ chos thams cad sems kyi rang bzhin yin pas/ sems kyi chos nyid rtogs na chos thams cad kyi de bzhin nyid rtogs pa yin no// des na/ sems kyi rang bzhin gzung 'dzin gnyis dang bral ba'i chos sku'i ngo bo de/ rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas byon yang rung*/ ma byon yang rung ste/ gnas pas na rtag ces bya'o// de la/ rnam par rtog pa rnams spangs pa// gzung dang 'dzin pa dang bral ba// ye shes 'dus ma byas pa ste// rgyu dang rkyen gyi ma bskyed pa// zhes gsungs so// de lta bu'i sems kyi chos nyid rtogs pa ni/ zag pa med pa'i sdom pa/ sa dang pos mngon sum yin te/ sems kyi stong nyid la nges shes skyes pa'i phyir ro// de la ji ltar skyes na/ gzugs brnyan nam/ sgyu ma yul gyi stong nyid mngon sum du rtogs pa bzhin du/ sems sgyu ma dang chu zla ltar/ rang gis rang la nges pa'i shes pa 'dren no// de ltar sems nyid stong pa nyid la nges pa thob pa la tshad mas nges pa zhes bya'o// rang rig rtog pa med pa yin// stong nyid mngon sum nges gyur pa// bde chen rtog pa med pa dang*// khyad par med pa skal mnyam mthong*// zhes gsungs pas/ nang du sems kyi stong nyid rtogs pa'i shugs kyis/ phyi'i yul stong par rtogs pa ni/ rnal (11na)'byor gyi mngon sum yin gsung*/ de yang*/ dang po'i shes pa ngos zin na de nyid yin te/ shes rab kyi mig gis sems la bltas la/ sems kyi ngo bo la thog mtha' yod pa ma yin te/

nam mkha' dang 'dra'o// dbus ni ci yang ma yin pa'i phyir bdag gis smra bar mi nus so// zhes gsungs te/ tha mal gyi shes pa'i ngo bo de la/ bsgom bya sgom byed kyi bsam gtan dang bral bas/ sgom du med de sgom pa'i mchog /ces bya'o// rang bzhin gyis dag pa'i sems kyi ngo bo stong nyid mngon sum du mthong ba de la/ chos kyi sku zhes bya ste/ de yang*/ zla ba tshes pa dang*/ seng ge phru gu'i dpe dang*/ byis pa chung ngu'i dpes rtogs par bya'o// de yang ma bcos par bzhag pas nyams su myong ste/ myong ba'i don de la/ yang dang yang du nges pa thob par bya// yun ring du gnas shing mi 'gyur ba la yon tan du mi lta/ 'ching ba'i bsam gtan du 'gro gsung ngo*// rang bzhin gyi ngo bo ni sems ma bcos pa yin te/ 'di'i don nyams su myong zhing rtogs pa thob pa ni/ skye 'jig dang bral ba dang*/ dus thams cad pa dang*/ rgyun chad med pa dang*/ mi 'gyur ba dang*/ thams cad la khyab pa dang*/ don de rnams nyams su myong zhing rtogs pa thob na/ don dam pa mthong ba yin te/ da ni su la'ang dri bar mi bya'o// zhes gsungs so// de yang dang po dmigs pa dang rtsol bas mi sgrub/ bar du mi gnas/ tha mar nyams dang rtogs pa dang ma bral bar bya'o// dus rtag tu dran pa rgyun chags kyi ting nge 'dzin dang mi 'bral bar bya/ lhan cig skyes pa'i nyams dang mi 'bral ba'i sgo nas/ zag pa med par lus sems phab ste sbyangs pa'i yon tan thob par bya/ byams snying rjes kun (11ba)nas bslangs pa'i byang chub kyi sems rnam pa gnyis dang mi 'bral bar bya'o// ༈ // chos rje rin po ches/ skal ldan jo mo la gdams pa'o// bla ma rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// rten gyi gang zag dad pa can skye shis 'jigs nas/ chos tshul bzhin du byed par 'dod pas/ dben pa'i gnas su/ bde ba'i stan la skyil krung gis bsdad la/ dbugs glod/ lus bsrang*/

mig sna rtser dbab/ lce rtse rkan la gtad/ lag pa mnyam bzhag bya/ byams snying rje byang chub kyi sems bsgom/ 'gro drug gi sems can ma rgan rnams kyi don du/ skye med kyi don bsgom snyam du bsam la/ rang yi dam gyi lhar sgyu ma tsam du mos pa byas la/ rang gi sems nyid ngo bo 'di dang por skye ba med/ bar du gnas pa med/ tha mar 'gag pa med/ dngos po kha dog tu grub pa med pas/ de sgom na yang*/ skye ba dang*/ gnas pa dang*/ 'gag pa dang*/ dngos po dang*/ kha dog tu grub pa med pas na/ sems kha dog dngos po gang du yang ma grub pas/ ma grub par/ sing nge*/ ye re/ lhang nge*/ lhan ne/ tsan ne/ lham me/ lhug ge /ma bcos par bsgoms pas/ sems la 'od gsal 'char/ lus la bde drod 'bar/ mtshan ma rang sar grol/ mnyam bzhag dang rjes thob khyad par med de/ dpe chu la kha ba babs pa dang 'dra/ sngar 'dris kyi mi dang phrad pa 'dra/ bde gsal mi rtog pa'i nyams 'char/ dbugs phyi nang du rgyu ba mi tshor/ rnam rtog la skyon du mi lta/ bying rgod kyi dbang du mi btang*/ yun thung la grangs mang du bsgom/ ngang ngam shugs kyis nam dang nyin mo 'ud 'ud 'char/ de ltar bsgoms pas/ mthar thug rang don du chos sku/ gzhan don du gzugs sku rnam (12na)gnyis 'char ro// nyams su blangs na dngos grub thob// lam 'bras bu dang bcas pa'o// 'gro drug sems can ma lus pa// phyag rgya chen po myur thob shog /ri khrod dpal gyi ldom bu bas/ skal ldan jo mo la gdams pa'o// gsangs nas bsgrubs na chos sku 'byung ngo*// rdo rje 'chang*/ tai lo pa/ nā ro pa/ mar pa chos kyi blo gros/ mi la bzhad pa rdo rje/ snyi sgom bsod nams rin chen/ sho sgom byang chub ye shes/ jo gdan legs mdzes/ de la slob dpon lha sgom gyis zhus pa'o//
